meta.name: design-mobile-apps
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design a mobile app or UI screens, when they mention their Sleek (sleek.design) projects, or when implementing Sleek designs in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把移动端界面的想法变成设计稿,并落到可运行的代码里
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在做 app 界面设计,还要把它实现成代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn mobile app interface ideas into designs and land them in working code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you design mobile interfaces and then implement them in code

howto.what: Claude 会调用 sleek.design 的接口，按你的描述建项目并生成 App 界面；每次生成后它会截图给你看，需要落地成代码时再取回界面 HTML。首次使用需先授权 SLEEK_API_KEY。
howto.when: 当你想设计移动 App 或 UI 界面、提到自己的 Sleek 项目，或要把 Sleek 设计实现成代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个记账 App：首页、列表页和详情页
say.note: Claude 建项目生成屏幕后截图给你看

say.text: 把当前激活版本的界面代码导出，做成 HTML 原型
say.note: 它会取回该屏幕的组件 HTML

say.text: 列出 Sleek 的设计参考，我挑一个做整体风格
say.note: 选中的 referenceId 为整个项目定风格

howto.what_en: Claude uses the sleek.design API to create a project and generate mobile app screens from your plain-language description, then screenshots each new or updated screen. It can also fetch the screen HTML for implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to design a mobile app or UI screens, mention your Sleek project, or implement a Sleek design in code (HTML, React Native, SwiftUI).

say_en.text: Design a budgeting app: home, list, and detail screens
say_en.note: Claude creates a project, generates the screens, then screenshots them

say_en.text: Export the active version's screen code as an HTML prototype
say_en.note: It fetches that screen's component HTML

say_en.text: List the Sleek design references so I can pick a style
say_en.note: The chosen referenceId seeds the whole project's style
